card.name: Scattered digits and mid-name pieces
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered spots such as a digit inside a number, a closing bracket, or the middle of a name like Clive. The settings vary between sports text, physics and drug labels.

modes.label: Digits inside numbers
modes.description: A digit or decimal point partway through a number, often in figures or thresholds.
